title: Village Compass
description: As the name suggests, it adds a village compass that helps you locate the nearest village.
body:
# 🧭 Village Compass

Tired of using external web tools like Chunkbase just to find a village? **Village Compass** is a lightweight, highly optimized server-side plugin that allows players to craft a special compass to locate the nearest village in real-time.

---

## 🛠️ Crafting Recipe
The recipe is completely **shapeless** (you can place the items anywhere on the crafting grid):
* **1x Compass**
* **1x Emerald**

Once crafted, you will receive your specialized Village Compass!

---

## 🌍 Real-Time Client Translation
This plugin features an intelligent localization system that checks the player's game language every second (**20 ticks**). The item name and its lore will dynamically translate inside your inventory without any commands!

### Currently Supported Languages:
* 🇪🇸 **Spanish:** "Brújula de Aldeas" with localized chat messages.
* 🇺🇸 **English:** "Village Compass" with a clean default interface.
* 🇯🇵 **日本語:** 「村のコンパス」 Full native text support.
* 🇨🇳 **中文:** 「村庄指南针」 Full native text support.

---

## ⚡ Performance & Technical Features
* **Zero Server Lag:** The heavy structure-searching logic (`locateNearestStructure`) only runs exactly when a player right-clicks. The background translation task uses 0% CPU as it only reads already saved data.
* **GeyserMC Bedrock Support:** Since the plugin utilizes purely native items and text components, Bedrock Edition players (mobile, console) can use it perfectly, and the compass needle will point accurately on their screens.
* **Highly Compatible:** Built on top of the stable `StructureType` API, ensuring compatibility across modern Paper and Purpur releases.
